general_information.name: OH—YES, SORRY, THAT’S ROBERT MILLER.
general_information.address: It’s 76 Lakeshore Road East… Oakville, Ontario.

current_concerns.primary_problems: It’s been sort of a blah stretch, really… not much pleasure in things, I get tired very easily, and I’ve been keeping to myself more than usual. Sleep’s been off too — taking forever to get off to sleep.
current_concerns.goals: Mostly I’d like to enjoy life again, and keep myself active… that’s the main thing.

medications.current_medications:
Medication 1: Name Or Description: Carbidopa-levodopa.; Dose: It’s the 25/100 mg tablets, one tablet three times a day.; Start Or Duration: Started in 2024, I believe.; Side Effects: Occasionally it makes me nauseated.
Medication 2: Name Or Description: Yes… there’s also latanoprost eye drops.; Dose: One drop in each eye nightly.; Start Or Duration: I started that in 2021.; Side Effects: None that I know of.
Medication 3: Name Or Description: Yes, allopurinol.; Dose: 100 mg daily.; Start Or Duration: 2019, I think.; Side Effects: None known.

medical_history.medical_conditions: There are a few… Parkinson’s disease, and then I’ve had prostate cancer before — that one’s in remission now.

family_psychiatric_history.family_psychiatric_history_details: Family member 1: Name Or Description: My granddaughter.; Diagnosis Or Condition: ADHD.; Additional Details: She was diagnosed when she was 9, that’s all I know.

substance_use.nonmedical_alcohol_use: Status: Current; Substance or product: Wine.; Quantity or frequency: Monthly.; Duration: I don’t know the exact duration. Just, you know, for a while.

education_employment_legal_history.highest_education: Bachelor’s degree… I was a teacher.
education_employment_legal_history.employment_history: Job 1: Name Or Description: Oakville District School Board.; Job Title: High school science teacher.; Dates: 1978 to 2013.

personal_history.early_childhood: I was born and grew up, just… you know, that’s where I started. Not much more to say there, really.
personal_history.adolescence_early_adulthood: School mostly, and then I became a teacher. That’s about the shape of it.
personal_history.significant_relationships: I’ve been married a long time — 49 years — and my wife has been very supportive.
personal_history.future_goals: Mostly to enjoy life and manage this illness.
